exact_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Sun Wukong roster hero.
Primary request: Create ONE original portrait using the project's own current concept art just opened in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-sun-wukong-codex/design/sun-wukong-front.png, as the identity, palette and miniature craftsmanship reference. This is new bust artwork, not a crop of the reference. Preserve this specific stern monkey warrior: golden sculpted fur swept up into a flame-shaped crest, peach-tan simian muzzle and ears, deeply set brown eyes, pronounced golden brow and cheek tufts, small pointed golden chin beard, and a gold forehead circlet with two opposing raised spiral curls in the center.
Scene/backdrop: plain empty charcoal gray.
Subject: one Sun Wukong, near frontal with both eyes clearly visible and looking toward the viewer, calm formidable expression. Upper chest and both shoulders in imperial red armor with gold borders and dragon-shaped gold shoulder plates from the reference; small dark leather crossing straps and the upper part of the gold chest ornament. Preserve golden fur #C99A4A, imperial red #B32A24 and armor gold #D8B04A; only use the reference's restrained blue #5A8FC8 if a small garment edge is visible. No invented blue face paint.
Style/medium: the project's premium hand-painted collectible tabletop miniature craftsmanship, sculpted resin-like fur locks, crisp coherent painted face planes, restrained brush texture, lacquered red armor and controlled warm metallic gold highlights. Original character bust illustration/render, not a photograph, human avatar, actor likeness or commercial model scan.
Composition/framing: square canvas; centered head, complete headgear, shoulders and upper chest. Full100 intended circular crop: the entire square is the crop box, with a centered circle whose diameter equals the full image side, no zoom. Pull back enough that the whole crest and circlet have at least 15 percent empty charcoal headroom and both ears and all head fur lie inside the central 55 percent of canvas width. Eyes centered horizontally at about 44 percent height. Leave generous clear margins around the whole head and circlet inside the imaginary circular boundary. Head occupies about 40 percent of canvas height; shoulders occupy the lower half and may extend into bottom corners. Keep the face readable; do not let shoulder dragons hide it. No staff, hands, full body, pedestal or separate props.
Lighting/mood: soft warm-neutral studio light and gentle fill; both eyes readable, strong sculpted forms without excessive shine.
Constraints: preserve this own-project identity and colors. Entire head, ears, crest, beard and circlet fully visible with breathing room. No tight face crop, cut-off headgear, extra headgear, helmet, plumes or crown. No lettering, numbers, logo, watermark, frame, badge, circular mask, UI, cards, collage, scenery, smoke, glow, commercial scans or photo-avatar treatment.

reference_use: Own current front design opened with view_image before the call and used as identity/style/palette context. Brand-new generation: no referenced_image_paths or num_last_images_to_include supplied. No commercial scans or avatar images opened.
